<!--
THE SEARCH BOX, shown on the Writing page and at the bottom of the home page (search.js does the searching).
Its gray text before you type: data-long on wider screens, data-short on phones. Change the words between the quotes.
The places it suggests, and extra words that lead to each place, are at the top of search.js.
-->
```{=html}
<div class="site-search" role="search">
  <div class="field">
    <span class="lens" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="10" y1="10" x2="20.6" y2="20.6" stroke="#33312E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="6.3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#33312E" stroke-width="2.4"/></svg></span>
    <label class="visually-hidden" for="site-search">Search the site</label>
    <input id="site-search" type="search" role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="site-search-results"
      autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"
      data-long="Search · this will become useful with time 😅"
      data-short="Search · useful in time 😅"
      placeholder="Search · this will become useful with time 😅">
    <kbd aria-hidden="true">/</kbd>
  </div>
  <div class="results" id="site-search-results" role="listbox" aria-label="Search results" hidden></div>
</div>
<script src="search.js" defer></script>
```
